svg.title: Diffusion Transformer
svg.desc: DiT cuts the latent into patches like a ViT; a transformer predicts the noise over patch tokens, with text conditioning by cross-attention or conditioning tokens.

svg.text: DiT: replace the U-Net denoiser with a Transformer over latent patches
